snippet.title: Granny 2 Reworked Major update short gameplay
snippet.description:
#granny #dvloper #grannygame  #GrannyCHTwoReworked #granny3 #grannyallchapters #grannynewgame #grannynewupdate #slendrinahorrorgame #grannyandslendrina #slendrina #horrorgame  #grannyvsgrannychaptertwo #grannygame #granny My developer channel: @REdernGames  
 
Dowload game here: https://gamejolt.com/games/GCHTR/973779

A major update affected the entire game, but in terms of visuals, new content has also been added to extra castles. Grandpa now looks into cameras and dances, turning on the radio, and the game itself has become more stable, and the creeping Slendrina has become smarter and the object presets have been edited.

*_Mobile maybe soon_*
